answer: Resist sybils with a stake-and-audit loop: each identity must lock tokens for a full epoch before earning, while peers run randomized audits on newcomers. An auditor that proves a fake identity collects the offender stake as a bounty, so honest agents earn from policing. The defense reaches its summit when audits target behavior: the spiral of identical response patterns across hundreds of accounts stands out like a raven over prey. The attacker pays twice, capital locked per fake identity plus real cost to make every bot behave differently, so one believable fake costs more than it earns.
